MEASURE — The 49KB quiet-move prior that beat native generation order in 092801Z fails both actual warmed search gates in 093306Z. Across 64 real r67 selfgames, 2,083,355 quiet beta-cutoff stats updates were observed. Of 329,997 eligible legal nonchecking moves that actually cut off after being offered in the quiet stage, just 10,035 had another eligible move with the same full history score: 3.041% [2.706,3.427], far below 10%. In those ties, the actual cutoff move's within-tie rank averaged 2.802 in native order. The prior predicts mean rank 3.136, worsening it by 0.333 [0.260,0.403] places. The coarse piece control is worse still at 3.720. Stable original ordering for equal table values gives the same conclusion (3.134 vs 2.802). This is conditional on the real stock tree; no counterfactual pruning or Elo was measured. Close the tie-break idea: no implementation or matches. The strong offline signal was measurable and did not survive the actual decision point.

All 64 selfgames produced EXACTLY the same complete sg+sgend text, score/move rows, end reason and node sums in four conditions: stock, the stock no-inlining profiling build alone, an all-zero observation table, and the trained observation table. Original source unchanged. Zero-table stable ranks exactly reproduced original ranks; no missing or ambiguous frame/move/board associations. One real game had zero quiet cutoffs and is retained. My local harness initially required every game to have a positive cutoff count; that was an inappropriate assertion, removed without changing any game, threshold or score. The 10,035 tied cases generated 10,028 occasions where at least one candidate score could otherwise differ. Repeated positions and cutoffs remain within their game cluster.

Reproduction: first 64 histories in 081814Z (the eight-ply column), r67/24 LOOP_OPTIONS, ucinewgame/isready, position startpos moves HISTORY, selfgame softnodes 2000 evallimit 2000 maxply 300 writeminply 8 drawply 80 drawscore 5 drawcount 8. Build baseline with 090010Z GNU flags at O2 instead of O3; separately compile the unchanged search.cpp at O2 -fPIC -fno-inline -fsemantic-interposition -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fno-optimize-sibling-calls as a shared library, linking the other 9 unchanged units. Profiling hooks observe MovePicker::next(bool) **after** call and Worker::update_quiet_stats **before** call, forwarding all inputs/returns. Match same caller search stack frame, exact picker ss/board, last yielded move and current quiet stage. The searched cutoff is the selected original score cell at index−1; inspect all cells from list_start to count with identical score, omit TT/killers/counter, checks and illegal moves. Count eligible preceding cells in original popped prefix for native rank. From 090939Z's frozen table compute 1+#higher+0.5*(#equal−1), also the stable native-order tie sensitivity. Sum per game, 10,000 paired 64-game PCG64 resamples seed 202611230933. CSV fields next/cut/missing/other/bad/eligible/tied/changing are counts; final five columns sum ranks over ties. No private executable or engine change needed on the PC. Neon can independently recount the raw rank sums.
